snippet.title: Phantom Shapes | Official Trailer | Co-op Horror Hide-and-Seek
snippet.description:
Phantom Shapes is a funny online co-op horror hide-and-seek game for 2 to 7 friends on Steam (Windows PC). Out December 17, 2026. Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5581730/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=coming_soon&utm_content=trailer

One player is the Phantom. It hides a cursed shape somewhere on the map and protects it. Up to 6 Workers on the night shift have to find it, with flashlights, scanners and proximity voice chat. If it gets foggy, run.

Send this to a friend you'd want to play with.

Four maps after hours: North Phantom Plaza (an 80s mall), Hotel Phantasma, After-Hours Museum and Moonmeadow High. A family-friendly horror comedy for players 13 and older.

Wiki: https://phantomshapes.wiki
Discord: https://discord.gg/SCJ4K4xg3e
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/phantom.shapes/
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@phantomshapes

Made by Nasser Made Games.
#PhantomShapes #coophorror #steamgames
